text: This capstone built six real layers on top of real AdventureWorks2012 data: a T-SQL warehouse, an automated Python validation script, and three genuinely independent front-ends for Executives, the Board, and Finance.

Chapter 7 wasn't a detour from that work — it was the point of it. Three independent paths to the same number existed specifically so they could disagree with each other, and when they did, a real error got caught and fixed before it ever reached the Board.

This Advanced tier closes out the Data Analyst to BI Engineer path's capstone sequence for Thornbury Cycle Supply Co., operating at the scale and cross-functional complexity a real BI engineer's role actually reaches.

A genuinely senior version of this project would push further still — automated reconciliation on a schedule, row-level lineage back to source data, and a formal process for the next schema change. Naming those honestly, rather than pretending this capstone covered everything, is itself part of the job.
